method: Independent direct HTTP status, redirect, media-type, byte-length and content-hash checks; page-level PDF text extraction for geography and Temasek portfolio evidence; direct Atlantica, ECP and Temasek review for ownership, legal close, current status and exit search

Bidco included more than ten institutional co-investors

All stated regulatory approvals had been received by October 25, 2024
The parties scheduled the court hearing for December 10 and expected closing on December 12, 2024
Atlantica states it was acquired by ECP and co-investors on December 12, 2024
Post-close expansion continued in the United States, Mexico, Europe and South America
The company remains a multi-region operating and development platform

exitSearch.result: No later ECP or Temasek sale, exit, recapitalization or signed ownership transfer was identified. ECP's current portfolio page and Temasek's March 31, 2026 investment pages continue to identify Atlantica, while Atlantica's current site records operating and acquisition activity after the take-private.

responseSourceHealthCorrections: The response's closing-announcement URL is a pre-close scheduling release and does not itself prove legal completion; Atlantica's current history page directly confirms acquisition on December 12, 2024.
The September 2025 presentation directly shows 61%, not 62%, of operating power capacity in North America; the independent decision uses the supported 61% figure.
Temasek's 2025 report confirms portfolio inclusion, while its current 2026 investment pages more directly establish ongoing co-investment status.

Current Atlantica materials use Atlantica Sustainable Infrastructure Ltd for the operating company and Atlantica Sustainable Infrastructure Group plc for an issuer; the queued plc name is preserved only as the historical acquired-company identity.
No named ECP fund, exact Temasek vehicle or investor-level ownership percentage was publicly disclosed.
